description: Mock external config for MCP query time window. The change ticket does not contain real begin/end time, so case_02 passes one change-level time window from this config.
notes: All 13 SOP tool-occurrence requests share the same change-level begin_time/end_time.
If the same location appears in multiple SOP stages, repeated requests may return the same logs inside this global window.
The LLM is expected to use operation_access_log.time_local and SOP order to decide which log belongs to which action.
